facts.business: IntraSoft Technologies is a technology-driven, multi-channel online retailer serving the U.S. market, acting as an e-commerce partner to small and medium-sized vendors by enabling products to be listed, marketed, sold, and fulfilled across leading online marketplaces through its proprietary platform.
